reasons.plausibility: It is strongly grounded in established principles of configurational entropy and enthalpy for phase stability in high-entropy alloys, and aligns with known effects of Al additions on microstructure.
reasons.testability: It outlines a clear experimental protocol (varying Al content, characterizing phases, and measuring properties) that would definitively confirm or refute the proposed threshold behavior.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a precise composition-based design strategy that integrates multiple performance criteria and a direct route to validate the role of lattice distortion in phase stability.
